# Historical 16.21 fixture

Exact public game/build snapshots from commit `092599b669b32d1448230b26310e82943cade193`, before the 16.22 bundle upgrade. Hashes are in provenance.json. These fixtures test the archived 16.21 Hex mechanisms and signed-feed contracts; they are never current recommendations and are excluded from installers. Current-patch acceptance must use data/game.json independently. Do not change patch labels to reuse these as current data.
